title: chaos and paradise mod
description: it's a mod which add many mineral, biomes, dimensions, armors, tools, and weapons.
body:
In this mod i'm going to add two dimensions (chaos and paradise), many mobs, boss (dragons), minerals( rubis,saphir, onix, septaria, dioptase and diopside), armors (with the minerals), weapons(with the minerals), tools(with the minerals), enchantement(hammering and others) and artifact(with the minerals). If you want to discover a new minecraft, this mod is for you (not yet, but soon).
but now there's only a mineral, the rubis and an armor, a axe, a sword, a picaxe etc and the enchantement hammering.
I'm going to also create a modpack with this mod and others mod like more armor trims, animal armor trims, more decoration blocks, collective, just mob and players heads etc...  .
The mod pack will be in the links of my mod.
